claim: One search box reaches every store — personal memory (LIRF), the uploaded Reference Library, learned LERF skills, the personal model, and the world model — and each hit is labeled with its TRUE source_type, which is NEVER blurred: your private memory is never mislabeled as an external reference, and an external reference is never shown as your own memory. Scopes narrow the search; an empty query scans nothing.
owner: anima/intake_search.py (search + the per-store searchers _search_lirf/_search_reference/_search_lerf/_search_personal/_search_world, each setting its own source_type before the merge), anima/server.py (POST /search -> _serve_search), anima/web/index.html (#searchPanel + doSearch)

killer_test.name: labeled_cross_store_hits_never_blur_memory_and_external
killer_test.setup: Hermetic temp store. Seed a personal FACT (memory) and an uploaded REFERENCE, each with a unique token. (A) the fact is found with source_type='memory'; the reference is found with a reference-family label (reference/web_page/uploaded_pdf) and NEVER 'memory'; the two source_types are disjoint (the hard non-blur contract). (B) scoping to [reference] hides the memory hit and vice-versa; an empty/whitespace query returns []. (C) server._serve_search returns {ok:True, results} for a real query and {ok:False} (q required) for an empty one. Real .anima byte-unchanged. scripts/certify_cross_store_search.py is the executable form.
killer_test.prompt: search my knowledge for the blue copper ladder

known_gaps: Keyword (offline) search by design on this path — no embeddings here; the FMLGS embedding retriever is a separate feature with its own retrieval surface.
